entities.summary: Amador City is a city in Amador County, California, United States. The population was 200 as of the 2020 census, up from 185 in 2010, making it the least populous city in California. Amador City is noted for being the smallest city in the state by area making up just .3 square miles in total. The current mayor is Sandra Staples.
